# Douglas Rosenberg

> Full-stack .NET software engineer specializing in Blazor, ERP systems, and enterprise integrations. Currently building an ERP system for a global nonprofit (Franciscan Friars); prior work includes Fortune 10 LLM-document-processing tooling and manufacturing ERP systems.

Blazor-focused .NET developer who turns sprawling enterprise systems into software people actually enjoy using. Available for freelance and consulting engagements only — not currently seeking full-time employment or recruiter outreach.

## Background
- Current: Full-stack .NET engineer, Friars ERP (Franciscan Friars) — secure data-masking pipeline, Salesforce/ERP sync, 50 custom reports serving 500+ staff
- Prior: Tackle.ai (LLM-powered document processing for a Fortune 10 client), TC Industries (enterprise manufacturing ERP), Shift (Angular/.NET on BridgestoneMarketing.com)
- Core stack: C#, .NET, Blazor, ASP.NET, SQL Server, Azure, Syncfusion, Figma, Angular, Docker

- [Building a Family Tree App with Blazor](https://dougrosenbergdev.com/blog/building-family-tree-blazor) (2026-08-09): Technical deep-dive into ArborKin — tree layout without JavaScript, drag-state ownership, and direct-to-Blob photo uploads.
